recipes.name: Beef Chow Fun (Gan Chao Niu He)
recipes.description: Wok-charred wide rice noodles with beef and sprouts - Cantonese breath of the wok.

steps.instruction: Sear beef hot; remove.
Noodles char undisturbed; toss soy mix.
Beef + sprouts + scallion; two flips only.

videos.videoTitle: Beef Chow Fun (干炒牛河) | Cantonese Beef Ho Fun Recipe

recipes.name: Cumin Beef (Ziran Niu Rou)
recipes.description: Xinjiang-style smoky cumin-chile seared beef.

steps.instruction: Velvet beef briefly.
Blast fry; aromatics in.
Cumin-chile shower; toss off heat.

recipes.name: Hong Shao Beef (Red-Braised)
recipes.description: Soy-caramel braised beef with star anise warmth.

ingredients.name: Light+dark soy, Shaoxing, Star anise, Ginger

steps.instruction: Caramelize sugar; coat beef.
Liquids in; braise covered 90 min.
Reduce glossy lacquer.

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Perfect Braised Beef (Hong Shao Niu Rou) - Easy Chinese Recipe

recipes.name: Kung Pao Beef
recipes.description: Sichuan peppercorn-tingle beef with peanuts.

steps.instruction: Fry chilies-peppercorn fragrant.
Beef flash-sear.
Sauce reduce; peanuts/scallion last.

recipes.name: Vegetarian Mapo Tofu
recipes.description: Mala tofu with mushroom-mince replacing the pork.

steps.instruction: Brown mushroom mince; bean pastes bloom.
Water + tofu gentle simmer 8 min (spoon-fold).
Starch thicken; pepper-scallion snowfall.

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli
recipes.description: Classic tender beef with broccoli in a savory oyster sauce

steps.instruction: Marinate beef with soy sauce and cornstarch for 15 minutes.
Stir-fry beef in hot wok until seared, set aside.
Cook broccoli with garlic, return beef, toss with oyster sauce.

videos.videoTitle: Easy Beef and Broccoli Recipe by Masterchef • Taste Show

recipes.name: Braised Beef Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Hearty braised beef noodle soup with rich soy-anise broth

steps.instruction: Braise beef with soy sauces, rock sugar, and star anise until tender.
Cook wheat noodles and blanch bok choy.
Assemble bowls with noodles, sliced beef, bok choy, and hot broth.

recipes.name: Five-Spice Braised Beef Shank
recipes.description: Warm five-spice braised beef shank, sliced thin for sharing

steps.instruction: Sear beef shank until deeply browned on all sides.
Combine with five-spice, soy sauces, rock sugar, and aromatics.
Braise gently until very tender, then slice thinly.

recipes.name: Black Pepper Beef
recipes.description: Bold black pepper beef with crisp onions and bell peppers

steps.instruction: Marinate beef with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Stir-fry beef in hot wok until browned, remove.
Cook vegetables, return beef, season with oyster sauce and cracked black pepper.

recipes.name: Water-Boiled Beef
recipes.description: Sichuan fire-poached beef in a chili and peppercorn broth

steps.instruction: Blanch cabbage with doubanjiang and aromatics, spread on a plate.
Poach marinated beef slices in spicy broth.
Pour over cabbage, top with peppercorns and chilies, sizzle with hot oil.

recipes.name: Hoisin Glazed Beef
recipes.description: Sweet and savory hoisin glazed beef with snap peas

steps.instruction: Mix hoisin, soy sauce, and rice vinegar for glaze.
Stir-fry beef until seared, add snap peas.
Pour in glaze and toss until coated and glossy.

recipes.name: Beef and Tomato Stew
recipes.description: Comforting Chinese beef and tomato stew with potato chunks

steps.instruction: Brown beef chunks and set aside.
Saute onion, ginger, and tomatoes until jammy.
Simmer beef with potatoes and tomato paste until thick and tender.

recipes.name: Scallion Beef
recipes.description: Tender beef strips with thick scallion segments and ginger

steps.instruction: Marinate sliced beef in soy sauce, wine, and cornstarch.
Heat oil until smoking, sear beef in a single layer.
Add scallion segments and ginger, toss until fragrant.

recipes.name: Spicy Beef Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Fiery Sichuan beef noodle soup with chili oil and minced beef

steps.instruction: Brown ground beef with doubanjiang until crispy.
Cook noodles and blanch bok choy.
Assemble bowls with noodles, spicy beef, hot broth, and chili oil.

recipes.name: Beef and Eggplant Clay Pot
recipes.description: Clay-pot braised beef and eggplant in savory bean sauce

steps.instruction: Sear eggplant pieces until golden, set aside.
Stir-fry beef with doubanjiang, garlic, and ginger.
Combine in clay pot, braise until eggplant is silky and beef is tender.

recipes.name: Ginger Beef
recipes.description: Tender beef slices with fresh ginger and aromatic scallions

steps.instruction: Marinate beef with soy sauce, wine, and cornstarch for 20 minutes.
Sear beef in hot oil with ginger strips until just cooked.
Toss with scallions, white pepper, and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Shredded Beef with Peppers
recipes.description: Sizzling shredded beef with mixed peppers in spicy sauce

steps.instruction: Slice beef into thin strips and marinate.
Stir-fry beef strips in batches until crisp-edged.
Toss with peppers, dried chilies, garlic, vinegar, and sugar.

recipes.name: Beef and Sweet Corn Soup
recipes.description: Silky Chinese sweet corn soup with tender beef slices

steps.instruction: Bring broth with corn and ginger to a simmer.
Add thinly sliced beef and cook until just done.
Drizzle beaten egg into soup, season with sesame oil and soy sauce.

recipes.name: Szechuan Beef Stew
recipes.description: Hearty Sichuan beef stew with star anise and chili bean paste

steps.instruction: Brown beef chuck cubes until deeply seared.
Saute doubanjiang, ginger, and garlic until fragrant.
Simmer beef with potatoes and spices until thick and tender.

recipes.name: Braised Beef Tendon
recipes.description: Gelatinous beef tendon braised in soy and aromatic spices

steps.instruction: Blanch beef tendon until collagen begins to soften.
Braise with soy sauces, rock sugar, ginger, and star anise.
Cook until tendon is meltingly soft and sauce is glossy.

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
recipes.description: The classic: diced chicken, peanuts, dried chilies, mala tingle.

steps.instruction: Chili-pepper oil fragrant.
Chicken sear till just done.
Sauce glaze; peanuts finish.

videos.videoTitle: Authentic Kung Pao Chicken Recipe | Flavor Badshah

recipes.name: Da Pan Ji (Big Plate Chicken)
recipes.description: Xinjiang chicken-potato-pepper stew served over wide noodles.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken; doubanjiang + spices bloom.
Potatoes + water; braise 30 min.
Peppers; ladle over boiled belt noodles.

videos.videoTitle: How to Make PERFECT Chinese Big Plate Chicken (Da Pan Ji) - The Secret Restaurant Recipe!

recipes.name: White Cut Chicken (Bai Qie Ji)
recipes.description: Poached-then-iced chicken, silky skin, ginger-scallion oil.

steps.instruction: Submerge-boil then off-heat poach 35 min.
Ice bath for jelly-skin.
Chop through bone; sauce pool alongside.

videos.videoTitle: White Cut Chicken – Chinese Poached Chicken

recipes.name: Three-Cup Chicken (San Bei Ji)
recipes.description: Sesame-soy-rice wine braised chicken with basil.

ingredients.name: Sesame oil : Soy : Rice wine (three cups)

steps.instruction: Fry ginger-garlic in sesame oil.
Chicken brown; liquids; reduce covered 20 min.
Basil wilt-in uncovered glossy.

recipes.name: Sesame Chicken
recipes.description: Crispy sesame chicken coated in a sweet and tangy glaze

steps.instruction: Coat chicken pieces in cornstarch.
Pan-sear chicken until golden and cooked through.
Toss in glaze of soy sauce, vinegar, and honey, top with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Cashew Chicken
recipes.description: Cashew chicken with crisp vegetables in a savory sauce

steps.instruction: Stir-fry diced chicken until white, set aside.
Cook bell peppers and water chestnuts with garlic.
Return chicken, add cashews and oyster sauce, toss to combine.

recipes.name: Ginger Scallion Chicken
recipes.description: Simple poached chicken with vibrant ginger-scallion oil

steps.instruction: Poach chicken thighs in seasoned broth until just cooked.
Make sauce from minced ginger, scallions, salt, and hot sesame oil.
Slice chicken and drizzle generously with ginger-scallion sauce.

recipes.name: Lemon Chicken
recipes.description: Tangy lemon chicken with a bright citrus sauce

steps.instruction: Coat chicken breast slices in cornstarch.
Pan-sear until golden on both sides.
Simmer lemon juice with broth and sugar, pour over chicken.

recipes.name: Chicken Lettuce Cups
recipes.description: Savory minced chicken in crisp lettuce cups

steps.instruction: Stir-fry ground chicken with garlic and diced water chestnuts.
Season with hoisin sauce and soy sauce.
Spoon mixture into lettuce leaves and garnish with scallions.

recipes.name: Spicy Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Fiery chicken noodle soup with chili oil and Sichuan pepper

steps.instruction: Cook noodles and blanch bok choy.
Stir-fry chicken with doubanjiang, garlic, and ginger.
Assemble noodles, chicken, and bok choy, ladle spicy broth and chili oil.

recipes.name: Chicken Sweet Corn Soup
recipes.description: Silky sweet corn soup with shredded chicken and egg ribbons

steps.instruction: Shred poached chicken breast.
Bring broth with corn to a simmer, add chicken.
Drizzle beaten egg, season with sesame oil and soy sauce, garnish with scallions.

recipes.name: Black Bean Chicken
recipes.description: Savory chicken with fermented black beans and garlic

steps.instruction: Rinse and chop fermented black beans.
Stir-fry chicken pieces until seared.
Add black beans, garlic, ginger, and peppers, toss with soy sauce.

recipes.name: Mushroom Chicken Clay Pot
recipes.description: Chicken braised with shiitake mushrooms in a sizzling clay pot

steps.instruction: Rehydrate shiitake mushrooms.
Brown chicken pieces with ginger and garlic.
Braise with mushrooms and soy sauces until rich and tender.

recipes.name: Sweet Chili Chicken
recipes.description: Glazed chicken with a sweet and mildly spicy chili sauce

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken in soy sauce, garlic, and ginger.
Pan-sear chicken until golden and cooked through.
Warm chili sauce with honey and vinegar, toss chicken in glaze.

recipes.name: Scallion Chicken Rice
recipes.description: Fragrant one-pot chicken rice with scallion and ginger

steps.instruction: Saute chicken with ginger and garlic.
Add rice and chicken broth to the pot.
Cook rice with chicken on top, drizzle scallion oil and soy sauce before serving.

recipes.name: Emperor Chicken
recipes.description: Elegant steamed chicken with goji berries and red dates

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken with wine, salt, and ginger.
Top with goji berries and red dates.
Steam over high heat until cooked through, drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Soy Sauce Chicken
recipes.description: Poached chicken in aromatic soy sauce broth until lacquered

steps.instruction: Combine soy sauces, rock sugar, and spices to make braising liquid.
Bring to a gentle simmer and lower chicken in.
Poach at low heat, turning occasionally, until deeply colored.

recipes.name: Chicken in Peanut Sauce
recipes.description: Chicken in a rich peanut sauce with scallions and chili

steps.instruction: Stir-fry diced chicken until golden.
Mix peanut butter with soy sauce, vinegar, and chili.
Toss chicken in peanut sauce, top with crushed peanuts and scallions.

recipes.name: Garlic Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Garlic-loaded chicken with crisp snow peas

steps.instruction: Coat chicken in cornstarch and sear until golden.
Stir-fry garlic cloves and snow peas until fragrant.
Return chicken, toss with soy sauce and oyster sauce.

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken Peanut
recipes.description: Spicy stir-fried chicken with peanuts

steps.instruction: Dice chicken and marinate in soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat oil and fry dried chili and peppercorn.
Add chicken and stir-fry until cooked.
Add peanuts, vinegar, and sugar, toss quickly.

recipes.name: Tomato & Egg Stir-Fry
recipes.description: China's most-made home dish: silky eggs through jammy tomatoes.

ingredients.name: Scallion & Sugar pinch & Soy few drops

steps.instruction: Scramble eggs soft-gold; remove.
Tomatoes down to saucy; sugar-season.
Eggs back; two folds; scallion.

videos.videoTitle: THE BEST Tomato Egg Stir Fry Recipe! (Simple & Quick Comfort Food)

recipes.name: Di San Xian
recipes.description: Earth's three fresh things: potato, eggplant, pepper stir-fried glossy.

steps.instruction: Pan-fry potato golden; eggplant soft; separately.
Garlic + peppers flash.
Glaze everything glossy.

videos.videoTitle: Di San Xian (地三鲜) | Chinese Potato Eggplant Pepper Recipe

recipes.name: Cong You Bing (Scallion Pancakes)
recipes.description: Flaky layered pancakes studded with scallion.

steps.instruction: Roll thin; paste + scallions; roll coil; flatten.
Rest 20 min; re-flatten.
Pan-fry medium oil both sides crisp-blistered.

videos.videoTitle: Scallion Pancakes Recipe from my Chinese Grandma 👵🏼

recipes.name: Tofu and Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Crispy tofu and broccoli in a savory garlic sauce

steps.instruction: Press tofu, cube, coat in cornstarch, and pan-sear until crispy.
Stir-fry broccoli with garlic and ginger.
Combine tofu and broccoli, toss in mushroom sauce.

videos.videoTitle: Broccoli and Tofu Stir Fry | Quick, Plant-Based & Full of Flavor #shorts

recipes.name: Sesame Crusted Tofu
recipes.description: Golden sesame-crusted tofu with a sweet soy glaze

steps.instruction: Press tofu, slice into slabs, coat in cornstarch and sesame seeds.
Pan-sear until golden and crispy on both sides.
Serve with glaze of soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and garlic.

recipes.name: Eggplant and Tofu Clay Pot
recipes.description: Silky eggplant and tofu braised in chili bean sauce

steps.instruction: Press and cube tofu, pan-sear until golden.
Saute eggplant with doubanjiang, garlic, and ginger.
Combine in clay pot with soy sauce and sugar, braise until silky.

recipes.name: Spicy Tofu Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Fiery tofu noodle soup with chili oil and scallions

steps.instruction: Press and cube tofu, pan-sear until crispy.
Cook noodles and blanch bok choy.
Assemble noodles, tofu, and bok choy, ladle spicy broth with chili oil.

recipes.name: Tofu Peanut Stew
recipes.description: Hearty tofu stew with peanuts in a savory sauce

steps.instruction: Press and cube tofu, brown in a pot.
Add doubanjiang, garlic, ginger, and peanuts.
Simmer until sauce thickens and tofu absorbs flavor.

recipes.name: Braised Daikon with Tofu
recipes.description: Gentle braised daikon radish with silky tofu

steps.instruction: Slice daikon and simmer in broth until translucent.
Add tofu cubes and soy sauce.
Braise gently until daikon is melting, finish with sesame oil and scallions.

recipes.name: Cold Sesame Tofu
recipes.description: Chilled silken tofu drizzled with sesame sauce

steps.instruction: Slice silken tofu and arrange on a chilled plate.
Whisk sesame paste with soy sauce, vinegar, and water.
Drizzle sauce over tofu, top with chili oil and scallions.

recipes.name: Chili Oil Tofu
recipes.description: Tofu cubes drenched in fragrant Sichuan chili oil

steps.instruction: Press tofu and cut into cubes.
Arrange on plate and pour chili oil over top.
Season with soy sauce, minced garlic, vinegar, and scallions.

recipes.name: Tofu Mushroom Rice
recipes.description: One-pot braised tofu and mushroom rice

steps.instruction: Press and cube tofu, brown in a pot.
Add sliced mushrooms, rice, and broth with soy sauce.
Cook until rice is fluffy and tofu has absorbed the savory broth.

recipes.name: Garlic Tofu Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Pungent garlic tofu with chili flakes

steps.instruction: Press and cube tofu, coat in cornstarch, pan-sear.
Stir-fry sliced garlic and chili flakes until fragrant.
Toss tofu in garlic-chili mixture with soy sauce and scallions.

recipes.name: Five-Spice Braised Tofu
recipes.description: Deeply flavored five-spice braised tofu

steps.instruction: Press and cube tofu, sear until golden.
Braise with five-spice, soy sauces, sugar, and ginger.
Cook until tofu has absorbed the warm aromatic sauce.

recipes.name: Tofu Vegetable Soup
recipes.description: Light tofu soup with mixed vegetables and ginger broth

steps.instruction: Bring broth with ginger to a simmer.
Add mushrooms, cabbage, and tofu cubes.
Simmer until vegetables are tender, season with soy sauce.

recipes.name: Wood Ear and Tofu Salad
recipes.description: Refreshing wood ear mushroom and tofu salad

steps.instruction: Rehydrate and slice wood ear mushrooms.
Slice tofu and arrange with cucumber and mushrooms.
Dress with soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, and chili oil.

recipes.name: Sweet Pepper Tofu
recipes.description: Tofu with sweet bell peppers in a glossy sauce

steps.instruction: Press and cube tofu, pan-sear until crispy.
Stir-fry bell peppers with garlic and ginger.
Add sweet bean sauce, toss tofu back in, thicken with cornstarch.

recipes.name: Clay Pot Tofu
recipes.description: Bubbling clay pot tofu with mushrooms and scallions

steps.instruction: Press and cube tofu, brown in clay pot.
Add mushrooms, ginger, and soy sauce.
Cover and braise until bubbling, finish with sesame oil and scallions.

recipes.name: Steamed Tofu with Herbs
recipes.description: Delicate steamed tofu with fresh herbs and soy drizzle

steps.instruction: Slice silken tofu and arrange on a steaming plate.
Steam for 8 minutes until heated through.
Drizzle with soy sauce, sesame oil, chili oil, and fresh herbs.

recipes.name: Soy-Braised Beef
recipes.description: Classic soy-braised beef chunks with rich caramelized sauce

steps.instruction: Brown beef chunks and caramelize rock sugar.
Add soy sauces, wine, and ginger.
Braise until beef is fork-tender and sauce is reduced.

recipes.name: Hong Kong Egg Tarts
recipes.description: Buttery pastry cups of barely-set sweet egg custard.

ingredients.name: Eggs + evaporated milk + sugar syrup custard

steps.instruction: Strain custard twice; rest to de-bubble.
Fill shells 80%.
Bake 200°C ~18 min until centers barely wobble.

recipes.name: Mango Pudding
recipes.description: Silky dim-sum mango set cream with fresh mango cubes.

steps.instruction: Blend mango smooth; warm milk-sugar-gelatin.
Combine; strain; pour cups.
Chill 4 hours; cube-top.

videos.videoTitle: Restaurant-Style Mango Pudding | Easy 2-Layer Mango Dessert Recipe | Mango pudding

recipes.name: Sesame Balls
recipes.description: Golden sesame-coated glutinous rice balls with sweet filling

steps.instruction: Mix glutinous rice flour with warm water into a dough.
Wrap sesame-sugar filling in dough balls, roll in sesame seeds.
Cook in hot oil until golden and hollow, drain on paper towels.

videos.videoTitle: Sesame Balls (煎堆/芝麻球) with Red Bean Paste Filling

recipes.name: Red Bean Sweet Soup
recipes.description: Sweet red bean soup with lotus seeds and tangerine peel

steps.instruction: Soak red beans overnight, simmer until very soft.
Add lotus seeds and tangerine peel, cook until tender.
Sweeten with rock sugar and finish with a splash of coconut milk.

recipes.name: Tang Yuan
recipes.description: Glutinous rice balls in sweet fermented rice broth

steps.instruction: Make sesame-sugar filling and roll into small balls.
Wrap filling in glutinous rice dough.
Cook in sweet ginger-laced fermented rice broth until balls float.

recipes.name: Taro Sweet Soup
recipes.description: Creamy taro and sweet potato soup with coconut milk

steps.instruction: Simmer diced taro and sweet potato until soft.
Add coconut milk and rock sugar.
Cook tapioca pearls separately, add to soup before serving.

recipes.name: Eight-Treasure Rice
recipes.description: Sticky rice pudding studded with eight dried fruits and nuts

steps.instruction: Soak and steam glutinous rice with sugar.
Arrange dried fruits and nuts in a bowl, pack with rice.
Steam again, then invert and drizzle with sweet sauce.

recipes.name: Osmanthus Jelly
recipes.description: Ethereal osmanthus and wolfberry jelly with rock sugar

steps.instruction: Steep osmanthus flowers in hot water to make fragrant tea.
Dissolve agar and rock sugar in osmanthus water.
Pour into molds with wolfberries and chill until set.

recipes.name: Almond Tofu
recipes.description: Silky almond tofu with fruit cocktail and sweet syrup

steps.instruction: Warm milk with sugar and almond extract.
Dissolve agar in warm milk, stir until smooth.
Pour into molds, chill until set, serve with fruit and syrup.

recipes.name: Coconut Milk Pudding
recipes.description: Creamy coconut milk pudding with palm sugar caramel

steps.instruction: Heat coconut milk with sugar and agar until dissolved.
Pour into cups and chill until set.
Melt palm sugar into a caramel sauce, pour over pudding.
